criterion.title: Feedback UI - Icons Display
criterion.given: I received an AI answer in the chat
criterion.then: I see two feedback icons below the response: Thumbs up icon (outlined initially) AND Thumbs down icon (outlined initially)

criterion.title: Feedback UI - Tooltips
criterion.given: I hover over the thumbs up icon

criterion.title: Feedback UI - Tooltips Down
criterion.given: I hover over the thumbs down icon

criterion.title: Positive Feedback - Submission
criterion.given: I clicked the thumbs up icon
criterion.then: the icon fills in (solid state) AND a success toast appears: "Thank you for the feedback!" AND the feedback is recorded with type: "positive" AND user_id is logged for audit trail

criterion.title: Negative Feedback - Form Display
criterion.given: I clicked the thumbs down icon
criterion.then: the icon fills in (solid state) AND a feedback form appears with the question: "What was wrong?" AND options are provided: Incorrect information, Not helpful/Irrelevant, Incomplete answer, Harmful or unsafe, Other (optional text)

criterion.title: Negative Feedback - Reason Selection
criterion.given: I selected a reason from the list
criterion.then: the feedback is recorded with: type: "negative", reason: selected option, additional_notes: optional text if "Other" selected, AND user_id, session_id, ip_address logged for audit trail

criterion.title: Negative Feedback - Other Text Field
criterion.then: a text field appears with placeholder: "Tell us more..." AND character count shows 0/500 chars

criterion.title: Feedback Persistence - Icon State
criterion.given: I provided feedback (thumbs up or down)
criterion.when: I look at the message again
criterion.then: the icon remains filled AND I cannot provide feedback twice for the same message AND I can change my feedback (click opposite icon to switch)

criterion.title: Feedback Change - Update Feedback
criterion.given: I change my mind and click the opposite icon
criterion.then: the old feedback is replaced with the new feedback AND a new reason form appears (if clicking down) AND previous reason is cleared AND change is logged in audit trail

criterion.title: Feedback Logging - User Tracking
criterion.then: the feedback is logged with my user account information AND timestamp and user_id are recorded AND session_id and IP address are captured for audit trail AND all feedback is traceable to prevent sabotage

criterion.title: Harmful Feedback - Alert with User Info
criterion.then: it is flagged for urgent review (logged as critical event) AND the system alerts moderation team with user info AND a full audit trail is created for investigation

criterion.title: Error Handling - Retry Mechanism
criterion.then: a retry button appears AND the icon remains in a pending state (semi-filled) AND max 3 automatic retries before showing error

criterion.title: Error Handling - Rate Limiting
criterion.then: a message appears: "Please wait before providing more feedback" AND icons are disabled for cooldown period

criterion.title: Analytics Integration - Feedback Aggregation
criterion.then: the feedback contributes to: Answer quality metrics, Bot confidence calibration, Trust Score calculation, Aggregate statistics (shown in analytics dashboard)

criterion.title: Moderation - Harmful Pattern Detection
criterion.given: a specific AI response has 3 "Harmful" feedback items
criterion.then: an alert is created for moderation review with user_id list AND timestamp of each feedback AND ability to investigate abusers

constraints.constraint: User Tracking Enabled: Feedback is logged with user_id, session_id, IP address to prevent sabotage. NO anonymous feedback.
Audit Trail Required: All feedback submissions create audit log entries with user_id, timestamp, action for compliance and investigation.
Abuse Detection: User patterns monitored to identify feedback spam or coordinated sabotage. 5+ "Harmful" in 1 hour = flagged.
Authentication Required: Feedback endpoint requires JWT token in Authorization header. Unauthenticated requests return 401.
Tenant Isolation: Feedback must be scoped to tenant_id (RLS enforced). No cross-tenant feedback leakage.
Data Minimization: Only store necessary feedback fields (user_id, feedback data, audit info). No additional PII beyond user_id.
Rate Limiting: Max 20 feedback items per 5 minutes per session to prevent spam. 1-minute cooldown enforced per user.
Analytics Caching: Aggregate stats cached with 1 hour TTL to reduce database load. Cache invalidated on each feedback submission.
Icon State Persistence: Filled icon remains after feedback submission. User can change feedback by clicking opposite icon.
Reason Form Modal: Shows only on thumbs-down click. Allows changing reason if user changes feedback.
Audit Logging: All feedback submissions logged in audit_logs table with user_id, timestamp, ip_address for regulatory compliance (GDPR, data access requests).
Moderation Alerts: "Harmful" feedback triggers alerts with user identification for investigation. No anonymous harmful feedback allowed.

interface.name: POST /api/v1/bots/:bot_id/feedback
interface.signature: POST /api/v1/bots/{bot_id}/feedback { answer_id: UUID, message_id: str, type: "positive"|"negative", reason?: str, additional_notes?: str } -> 200 { success: bool, feedback_id: UUID }
interface.notes: Requires authentication (JWT token). Extracts user_id from token, session_id and ip_address from request. Creates audit log entry. Rate limited: 20/5min per session.

interface.name: GET /api/v1/bots/:bot_id/feedback/stats
interface.signature: GET /api/v1/bots/{bot_id}/feedback/stats -> 200 { total: int, positive_count: int, negative_count: int, negative_reasons: {...}, harmful_count: int }
interface.notes: Requires bot owner authentication. Returns aggregate stats (no individual feedback). 1 hour cache TTL. Cache invalidated on new feedback.

interface.name: GET /api/v1/moderation/alerts
interface.signature: GET /api/v1/moderation/alerts -> 200 { alerts: [{ bot_id, answer_content, feedback_count, user_id_list, created_at }] }
interface.notes: Bot owners see alerts for their bots. Admins see all alerts. Includes user_id list for investigation.

interface.name: GET /api/v1/moderation/user-abuse
interface.signature: GET /api/v1/moderation/user-abuse -> 200 { suspicions: [{ user_id, feedback_count_1h, harmful_count, ip_addresses, feedback_ids, created_at }] }
interface.notes: Admins only. Shows suspicious users with pattern analysis (5+ "Harmful" in 1 hour). Includes IP addresses and feedback IDs for investigation.

interface.name: FeedbackBar Component
interface.notes: Renders below each AI message. Shows thumbs-up/down icons. Handles click events and state management.

interface.name: FeedbackReasonModal Component
interface.signature: <FeedbackReasonModal isOpen={bool} onSubmit={(reason, notes) => void} onCancel={() => void} />
interface.notes: Modal for negative feedback reason selection. Shows radio buttons for reasons and text field for "Other" option.

interface.name: FeedbackService
interface.signature: async record_feedback(user_id, bot_id, answer_id, type, reason, notes, session_id, ip_address) -> feedback_id
interface.notes: Handles feedback submission, validation, storage, audit logging, and moderation alerts. Detects abuse patterns.

interface.name: AuditService
interface.signature: async log_feedback(user_id, feedback_id, type, ip_address, session_id, details) -> audit_log_id
interface.notes: Creates audit log entries for feedback submissions with full traceability (user_id, timestamp, ip, session).

tests.standards: Follow test patterns from Story 4.1 (chat interface). Unit tests isolate components with mocks. Integration tests verify feedback is submitted with correct user tracking. E2E tests verify end-to-end feedback flow: submit positive/negative → verify logged → verify audit trail created. Test frameworks: Vitest + React Testing Library (frontend), pytest + FastAPI TestClient (backend). All tests must verify user tracking (user_id in logs), authentication enforcement, and abuse pattern detection.
tests.locations: Frontend tests: apps/web/__tests__/ (Vitest discovers .test.tsx files). Backend tests: apps/api/tests/ (pytest discovers test_*.py files). E2E tests: apps/e2e/ (Playwright).
